title: The Stronghold of AD 500
text: After Roman rule ended, South Cadbury was massively refortified with new defences, gateworks and a great timber hall. Archaeologists believe it was an important power centre in western Britain during the time traditionally associated with Arthur.

title: Is This Camelot?
text: The association between South Cadbury and Camelot was recorded by antiquary John Leland in 1542. Archaeology cannot prove Arthur lived here, but it has revealed a major fortified centre dating to the right period.
